title: Garden setts
note: Regular pale setts and hanging lamps suit the clipped hedges.

title: Reclaimed stone
note: Moss-dark fieldstones and timber lanterns follow the pine succession.

title: Orchard brick
note: Warm orchard bricks and timber lanterns echo fruit and bark.

title: Pilgrim slabs
note: Broad worn slabs and votive flames frame the scattered waystones.

title: Lantern tiles
note: Teal tiles with warm inlays turn the lantern route into an evening destination.

title: Scorched stone
note: Blackened stones and ember seams lead between flame pillars.

title: Siege track
note: Coarse rubble and exposed flames give the barricades a makeshift setting.

title: Moonlit steps
note: Cool stepping stones and soft green orbs leave the mushrooms prominent.

title: Seaside boards
note: Sun-bleached boards and tall lamps make a coastal promenade.

title: Meadow steps
note: Spaced green-grey stones and simple timber lamps sit lightly in the meadow.

title: Park brick
note: Orderly buff bricks and traditional street lamps define a tended park.

title: Gilded avenue
note: Gold inlays and tall lamps make the coin route ceremonial.

title: Trapper track
note: Dry gravel and weathered timber lamps blend with dirt, bones and snares.

title: Bramble stones
note: Uneven grey stones and small candles give the thickets a secluded feel.

title: Camp planks
note: Rough dark planks and naked flames connect the barrel camps.

title: Offering steps
note: Honey-coloured stones and paired candles mark the shrine approach.

title: Damp cause stones
note: Blue-green slabs and green lights suggest persistent damp around the slimes.

title: Webbed crypt slabs
note: Violet-grey slabs and low candles leave pale webs easy to see.

title: Venom tiles
note: Sour green inlays and orb lights echo the poisonous vents.

title: Ember slabs
note: Dark volcanic slabs with copper tones lead past the fire vents.

title: Violet inlay
note: Muted violet tiles and cool lights echo the toxic vines.

title: Twilight weave
note: Alternating violet and teal bricks give the dreamlike path a restless rhythm.

title: Forager stones
note: Warm irregular stones and wooden lamps support the berry-lined lane.

title: Berry stepping trail
note: Widely spaced stones preserve the feel of a narrow foraging trail.

title: Kiln brick
note: Two-colour terracotta herringbone and low flames echo the clay pots.

title: Market setts
note: Hard-wearing warm setts and hanging lanterns suit the trading barrels.

title: Broken shale
note: Coarse pale gravel and stone fire pedestals reinforce the loose-rock terrain.

title: Grassland steps
note: Sparse pale stones and timber lanterns let the grass dominate.

title: Forest relics
note: Large moss-dark stones and timber lanterns sit beneath old trees.

title: Funeral setts
note: Cold dark setts and small candles echo the headstones and dead trees.

title: Patchwork tiles
note: Clay, sage and ochre tiles reflect the route’s varied finds.

title: Raised timber way
note: A dry timber deck and tall lamps keep the route distinct from its verge pools.
